notes: RBox revision of a subproperty: removes a true one (a country's capital is located in it), so the instances' new answers go against world knowledge. The propositional queries state the edit positively ('a city can be the capital of a country without being located in that country'). The first instance (and the cross-lingual queries) asks 'given only this, could it be that ... not located in ...?' (no, then yes), the second whether location follows (yes, then no, 'given only this'). The axiom is written as the negation of capital_of subproperty of located_in. Near asks the same property of the largest city in plain wording (yes). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
